name: Maid no Susume
source:
Kejime is a wealthy, but brutally cruel businessman. He wants nothing more than to control and abuse those around him. Among his victims are Satsuki, a homeless girl whom he has crushed into being his loyal sex slave, and his own son, Susumu.

Susumu, seeking to lead his own life free from his father's control, is studying for his college exams. Kejime, who sees him as little more than his own possession, wants him to go directly into his business and despises the idea of him going to college. 

Seeking to help her master, Satsuki devises a proposition. Susumu will be given a series of ten tests. If he passes them, he will be free to go to college and live his own life. If he fails any of them, Susumu will give up on his ambitions and work in his father's company. However, Satsuki is doing everything in her power to rig the tests against him.

Susumu's only allies are two of his fathers maids, Komachi and Nabata, who care for him deeply, and have been the only source of warmth in his life. Will their tutoring be enough to free him from his father's grip?
translation:
Kejime是一位富有但残酷的商人。他只想控制和虐待周围的人。他的受害者包括无家可归的女孩小月（Satsuki）和他自己的儿子进（Susumu），小月被他压榨成他忠实的性奴隶。

苏苏姆正在为大学考试而学习，试图摆脱父亲的控制，过上自己的生活。克吉梅认为他只不过是自己的财产，希望他直接从事自己的生意，并且鄙视他上大学的想法。

为了帮助她的主人，小月提出了一个提议。Susumu将接受一系列十项测试。如果他通过了考试，他将可以自由地上大学并过自己的生活。如果他失败了其中任何一个，Susumu就会放弃他的野心并在他父亲的公司工作。然而，小月正在尽一切努力来操纵针对他的测试。

进唯一的盟友是他父亲的两个女仆小町和名田，她们深深地关心着他，是他生命中唯一的温暖源泉。他们的辅导足以让他摆脱父亲的控制吗？
